rejected_candidates.name: Ultra-Thin Microflute Carton
rejected_candidates.failed_check: Clearance check (4.0 mm < required 15.0 mm minimum)
rejected_candidates.explanation: Internal clearance is below the 25.0 mm buffer required for HIGH fragility. Risk of cosmetic abrasion and impact damage during drops.

rejected_candidates.name: Single-Wall Economy 3-Ply
rejected_candidates.explanation: Calculated BCT (142.0 kgf) cannot safely sustain a full 5-layer warehouse stack under 30-day ambient storage without sidewall buckling.

rejected_candidates.name: Oversized Universal Box
rejected_candidates.failed_check: Pallet Overhang (45 mm overhang exceeds Euro Pallet 0 mm limit)
rejected_candidates.explanation: Carton footprint exceeds 1200×800 mm boundary, causing overhang and high risk of carton corner crushing against adjacent pallets in transit.

ai_recommendation.explanation: The Tornado table blender's 'Balanced Engineering Fit' utilizes a corrugated carton with external dimensions of 240.0 x 225.0 x 450.0 mm. This design incorporates a 25.0 mm internal clearance, an ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION derived from ISO 2248 for high fragility, to ensure product protection. The BC Double Wall board provides a McKee Box Strength of 265.6 kgf, resulting in a robust compression safety factor of 33.2, which significantly exceeds the 4.5 minimum required by ISO 2234 (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION for stacking). This efficient design allows 45 units per Euro pallet (1200x800 mm, zero overhang as per ISO 3676/3394) and achieves a substantial 58.7% volume savings, contributing to the ISO 18602 optimisation target. Please note, these recommendations are based on ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTIONs from the NxtPak Registry; physical lab tests (ISO 2234, ISO 2248) are essential for final validation.
ai_recommendation.confidence_reason: High confidence: Complete product dimensions, net weight, and baseline carton specifications provided. All compression and palletization values calculated via deterministic equations.
assumptions: ISO 2248 ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Clearance 25.0 mm ≥ 25.0 mm floor for HIGH fragility. Physical drop test required.
ISO 2234 ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Safety Factor 33.20 ≥ 4.5 for 30-day ambient stacking. Physical stacking test required.
ISO 3676/3394: Pallet boundary 1200×800 mm Euro Pallet. 15 cartons/layer.
ISO 18602: Volume utilisation target ≥ 60%. Right-sizing validated by deterministic parametric calculation.
Board ECT values assume standard commercial linerboard (175/127/175 gsm kraftliner equivalent).
Warehouse storage assumes 23°C / 50% RH ambient conditions without direct weather exposure.
These constraints are ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTIONs derived from the ISO registry. Physical lab tests (ISO 2234, ISO 2248) must validate them before production.
missing_data: 3D CAD model (STEP/STL) to locate precise center of mass and optimize cushion contact points.
test_plan: ISO 2234: Complete static stacking test at safety factor 4.5 for 30 consecutive days under 50% RH.
ISO 2248: Free-fall drop test from 800 mm height across 10 orientations (1 corner, 3 edges, 6 faces).
ISO 13355: Random vibration profile simulation for 180 minutes representing road and freight transit.
